name: exp-card
author: BlaXun
description: Every monster kill has a chance to drop a tiered Exp Card, bound to the killer for the standard pickup window. Two families -- Base Exp Cards and Job Exp Cards -- each with ten levels; higher-level mobs drop higher-level cards. At 1x, a card grants about 5% of the next level at the lowest level that may use it (a level 10 card: 30,000 exp, from base level 91); card exp scales with the server's Base/Job EXP rates. Streamlines offline levelling without touching per-mob drop tables.

settings.label: Drop chance (0.01% units)
settings.description: Odds a card drops from any given monster kill, in 0.01% units. 200 = 2% (the default), 100 = 1%, 1000 = 10%. At ~150 kills per hour and a 50/50 base/job split, 2% is about 1.5 cards an hour on whichever axis the player is pushing, each worth 3-5% of a level where it drops: ~4.5-7.5% of a level per hour. Which card (base or job, level 1-10) is decided per drop -- see the mod's README.
